layer.capability: Evaluate a conditional analytic majorant for omitted radial coefficient rows from a supplied global AxisCoefficientSpace norm upper bound.
layer.factory: axis_coefficient_radial_tail_bound(norm_upper, epsilon, Y, max_n, eta_order=0, radial_order=0, average=False)

arithmetic.exact_intermediate: Fraction from supplied Decimals plus integer factorials/binomials
arithmetic.final_conversion: nonnegative rational to Decimal with precision 96 and ROUND_CEILING

domain.indices: max_n, eta_order, radial_order are nonnegative integers

validation.scope: bounded compile and one exact simple-case smoke

layer.remaining_boundary: The module does not establish the global norm hypothesis, attach a guessed norm to finite rows, include coefficient roundoff, prove formal-solver convergence, or certify a paper-exact profile.

forbidden_inferences: a finite coefficient prefix supplies norm_upper
conditional_on_global_norm means global AxisCoefficientSpace membership has been proved
the derived negative-binomial estimate is itself a pinned Lean tail theorem
Decimal ROUND_CEILING output includes coefficient-evaluation roundoff
the radial-tail bound proves convergence or paper-exact velocity
